text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Very well then! Let us begin our Team
Bakushin training! Is everyone
ready?

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Yup!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to see where everyone's endurance
is at, so let's run some
ramps!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A suggestion! Let's do the ramped course
on unicycles! I found some
in the
equipment shed this morning!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What?! Why unicycles all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?
There's a good reason why
I made the suggestion...
Because it'd be
fun, duh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Is that it? So it doesn't have anything to
do with endurance?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll up the ante then! Whoever can
complete the course within
the fewest
pedals wins!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A friendly competition? Sounds fun! Oh,
we should probably cover
the track with
some planks, right? I'll do that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That's the spirit! All right! Well,
today's training will be a unicycle
battle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoever comes in last place has to buy us
all yakisoba buns on the
way home!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hey, sorry to leave you with the first
running segment.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's fine...
You'd be hopeless if the mission
was something finicky like
kendama or a
3-point shot anyway.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! Top Road's swimming is as
dynamic as a dolphin show!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
W-wait... She's making such a splash,
she's
about to drown Doto next
to her!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh look, Top Road is comi—weeegh! She's
driven her whole bike into
a bush!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! A rendezvous with the tree
fairies cleverly disguised as
an unfortunate
blunder! Wish I'd thought of that one!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not like you usually have any
reason to ride a bike. It's faster
to run, so
it makes sense you can't ride one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm not very good with intricate
stuff. I actually wasn't going to
enter the
triathlon because of that...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But since I've been trusted with the
running section, I'm going to rise
to the
responsibility! So Ayabe, please do a
partner run with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Ayabe is still behind me,
so if I just sprint
now... I can make it!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe?! Where did that speed come
from?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Guh... RRRAH!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I guess I have to start sprinting
earlier...
But if the distance was just a
bit longer,
then that timing would've worked...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Do you want to run the same distance
again for the next one? I'd
like to try a
longer one if you're up for it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's try a longer race this time!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's about time I started heading home.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
I'm going to stay and run a little bit
longer!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Don't overdo it though. Well, see
you later.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you for today! Bye!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I realized while I was running with
Ayabe... I need to learn more
about pacing
and positioning.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I was too clumsy for swimming and
cycling, so I have to put my all
into
running!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I'm going to put aside more time
for research and training!
